{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Print basic info
sales.info()

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print(f"Number of -1 in customer_age: {sales[sales['customer_age'] == -1].shape[0]}")

# Check revenue format
print(f"Unique revenue values (first 10): {sales['revenue'].unique()[:10]}")

# Check status values
print(f"Status value counts:\n{sales['status'].value_counts()}")

# Check for QA orders
print(f"Number of rows with revenue 999999.99: {sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99'].shape[0]}")"}
